verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents official SDKs across multiple languages (Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R, Java) built on DuckDB, plus an official CLI, MCP servers (local and remote), and an OpenAPI spec confirmed by probes. This directly supports AI-native/agentic developers building against official interfaces, with runtime probes confirming keyless SDK, CLI, and MCP functionality. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking or reviews of SDK completeness/quality beyond vendor docs.
